disambiguation: It modifies the visual display of file names in the sidebar only, without changing the actual file name on disk.
intentEvidence: Originally created as simple “Zettelkasten ID Hider,” this plugin has evolved into a flexible tool for styling file names based on regex or timestamp-based IDs.
motivation: The plugin originated as a tool to hide Zettelkasten IDs from file names.
problem: Users need a way to visually organize and clean up file names in the sidebar, especially those containing long IDs or timestamps, without permanently changing the underlying file names.

relations.evidence: Originally created as simple “Zettelkasten ID Hider,” this plugin has evolved into a flexible tool for styling file names based on regex or timestamp-based IDs.

summary: FileName Styler allows users to customize and style file names in the Obsidian file explorer using patterns, regex, prefixes, suffixes, colors, and icons.
